questions.question: When is Roger Federer scheduled to be inducted into the International Tennis Hall of Fame (ITHF)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**August 2026.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Roger Federer will be inducted into the International Tennis Hall of Fame during a ceremony scheduled for August 2026 in Newport, Rhode Island, marking a historic milestone for the 20-time Grand Slam champion.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Federer retired in 2022 after winning 20 Grand Slams and 103 career titles.**
 
• **He held the world number one ranking for a record 237 consecutive weeks between 2004–2008.**
 
• **Overall, he spent 310 weeks at the top of the ATP rankings during his career.**
 
• **The induction ceremony will take place in Newport, where Federer will join legendary champions of tennis history.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **About the International Tennis Hall of Fame (ITHF)**__

 __
 
• Founded: 1954
 
• Location: Newport, Rhode Island, USA
 
• Purpose: Honours players and contributors for outstanding achievements in tennis.
 
• Features: Museum, grass courts, and the annual Newport ATP event.
 
 
 
• **Federer’s Career Highlights**__
 __
 
• Grand Slams: 20
 
• ATP Titles: 103
 
• Notable Rivals: Rafael Nadal, Novak Djokovic
 
• Retired: 2022
 
 
 
• **ATP Rankings Records**__
 __
 
• 237 weeks as World No. 1 consecutively (record)
 
• 310 total weeks as World No. 1
 
 
 
• **Big Three Era**__
 
 
• Federer, Nadal, and Djokovic dominated men's tennis for two decades.
 
• They collectively elevated global popularity of the sport.

questions.question: What prestigious French civilian award was conferred upon veteran art director Thota Tharani?

options.text: Knight of the Legion of Honour
Chevalier de l’Ordre des Arts et des Lettres
Grand Cross of the Legion of Honour

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Chevalier de l’Ordre des Arts et des Lettres.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Thota Tharani, renowned art director, was awarded the Chevalier de l’Ordre des Arts et des Lettres by the French government for his contributions to arts and cinema.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The award was presented by the French Ambassador to India on November 13, 2025, at Alliance Française in Chennai.**
 
• **Tharani’s work spans over four decades, with notable contributions to films like “Nayakan,” “Thalapathi,” and “Ponniyin Selvan I & II.”**
 
• **The award places him alongside prominent Indian cultural icons who have received this prestigious French honor.**
 
• **Tharani’s work has been recognized for its cultural preservation, architectural accuracy, and artistic innovation in cinema.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Chevalier de l’Ordre des Arts et des Lettres**__

 __
 
• One of the highest civilian awards conferred by the French Republic.
 
• Awarded to individuals who have made significant contributions to the arts and literature globally.
 
 
 
• **Thota Tharani’s Career**__
 __
 
• Tharani is known for redefining art direction and production design in Indian cinema.
 
• His work spans multiple languages including Tamil, Telugu, and Hindi.
 
 
 
• **Notable Films**__
 __
 
• Tharani’s contributions to films like “Sivaji,” “Dasavatharam,” and “Sagara Sangamam” are widely celebrated.
 
• His art direction is known for its attention to cultural and historical authenticity.
 
 
 
• **Indian Honors**__
 
 
• Tharani has received numerous accolades including the Padma Shri in 2001 and multiple National and State Film Awards.

questions.question: When is the International Day for Biosphere Reserves observed, and who proclaimed it?

options.text: 29th December, proclaimed by CBD Secretariat in 2020

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**3rd November, proclaimed by UNESCO in 2021.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **3rd November** marks the International Day for Biosphere Reserves__, proclaimed by **UNESCO’s General Conference in 2021** and first celebrated in **2022**.
 
• The day emphasizes the crucial role of __biosphere reserves__ in biodiversity conservation and sustainable development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **UNESCO’s Man and the Biosphere (MAB) Programme** governs biosphere reserves globally.
 
• There are 738 biosphere reserves in 134 countries__, including __22 transboundary sites__.
 
• Globally, over **260 million people** live in these areas covering around **7 million sq km**—nearly the size of Australia.
 
• Biosphere reserves aim to balance __human activity with ecological conservation__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **India has 18 Biosphere Reserves** covering 91,425 sq km__, with __13 recognized by UNESCO__.
 
• The __Cold Desert Biosphere Reserve__ was newly added in **2025**.
 
• India operates its biosphere reserve programme under a __Centrally Sponsored Scheme__ with **60:40 funding** (90:10 for NE & Himalayan states).
 
• __India ranks 9th__ globally in total forest area and __3rd__ in annual forest gain (FAO 2025).
 
• **Related schemes:** Project Tiger, Project Elephant, Integrated Development of Wildlife Habitats, and the National Biodiversity Action Plan (implementing the Biological Diversity Act, 2002).

questions.question: Which two countries will co-host the 2026 FIH Hockey World Cup?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Belgium and Netherlands.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The 2026 FIH Hockey World Cup will be co-hosted by Belgium and the Netherlands in a historic dual-host format.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Belgium (Wavre) and Netherlands (Amsterdam) will jointly host both men’s and women’s tournaments.
 
• The event runs from 15 to 30 August 2026 with 16 teams per gender.
 
• Men’s final will be held in Wavre, while the women’s final will be in Amsterdam.
 
• This edition includes the first-ever ParaHockey World Cup to promote inclusivity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Wavre – Belfius Hockey Arena**__

 __
 
• Main venue in Belgium.
 
• Hosts the men’s final.
 
• Modern international-standard facility.
 
 
 
• **Amsterdam – Wagener Stadium**__
 __
 
• Main Dutch venue.
 
• Hosts the women’s final.
 
• One of the world’s most iconic hockey stadiums.
 
 
 
• **New Tournament Format**__
 __
 
• 16 teams divided into 4 groups per gender.
 
• Top two teams enter second-round group phase carrying forward results.
 
• Ensures fairer progression and sustained competition intensity.
 
 
 
• **ParaHockey World Cup**__
 
 
• First time included in the FIH World Cup lineup.
 
• Features athletes with intellectual disabilities.
 
• Held at the same venues as the main event.

questions.question: Name the typhoon that brought heavy rains and strong winds over the central Philippines in November 2025.
questions.solution:
Answer: **__Typhoon Kalmaegi__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Tens of thousands evacuated as **Typhoon Kalmaegi** (locally named Tino) hit the** central Philippines in November 202**5, bringing torrential rains, strong winds, and storm surges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Kalmaegi made landfall with sustained winds of **150 kph** and gusts up to **205 kph**.
 
• The typhoon affected the **Visayas region**, southern **Luzon**, and northern **Mindanao**.
 
• Over **160 flights** were cancelled, and authorities warned of **3-metre-high storm surges** in coastal areas.
 
• PAGASA reported that despite slight weakening, Kalmaegi remained at typhoon intensity while crossing the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Philippines experiences an average of **20 tropical storms** annually, making it one of the most disaster-prone countries in the Asia-Pacific region.
 
• Triggered floods, landslides, and 3-meter storm surges, severely impacting Cebu, Leyte, Samar, and Negros Occidental.
 
• At least 26 people killed, mostly in Cebu, and hundreds of thousands displaced amid widespread destruction.

questions.question: Who won the Don Award 2025, the highest accolade in Australian sport?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Oscar Piastri.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Oscar Piastri was awarded the prestigious Don Award 2025 in recognition of his stellar performances during the Formula One season.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The Don Award, named after Sir Donald Bradman, is presented annually by the Sport Australia Hall of Fame to athletes who inspire the nation through their achievements and character.**
 
• **Piastri’s breakthrough season in Formula One included seven Grand Prix wins, positioning him as a serious contender in the 2025 F1 Drivers’ Championship.**
 
• **The award celebrates Piastri’s consistency, professionalism, and national pride, marking a significant moment for Australian motorsport.**
 
• **Piastri’s recognition also signals Australia’s growing presence and legacy in international motorsport.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Don Award**__

 __
 
• Named after Sir Donald Bradman, the Don Award honors athletes who have inspired the nation with their exceptional achievements and sportsmanship.
 
• The award is presented by the Sport Australia Hall of Fame and is considered one of the highest honors in Australian sport.
 
 
 
• **Oscar Piastri’s Performance**__
 __
 
• Piastri won seven Grand Prix races in the 2025 season, including victories in China, Bahrain, Saudi Arabia, and more.
 
• His performances have drawn comparisons with Australian Formula One legends Mark Webber and Daniel Ricciardo.
 
 
 
• **Australian Motorsports Legacy**__
 
 
• With Piastri’s success, Australian motorsport has seen a resurgence, with the young driver becoming a role model for future generations of racers.

questions.question: With which country has India partnered to enable real-time cross-border remittances by linking UPI with the country’s Electronic Fund Transfer System (EFTS) through the Fawri+ service?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bahrain.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **NPCI International Payments Limited (NIPL) and BENEFIT, Bahrain’s leading fintech company, have partnered to enable real-time cross-border remittances between India and Bahrain.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The partnership connects India’s Unified Payments Interface (UPI) with Bahrain’s Electronic Fund Transfer System (EFTS) via the Fawri+ service.**
 
• **T**he collaboration enables users in both countries to send and receive money instantly and securely.
 
• It was developed under the guidance of the Reserve Bank of India and the Central Bank of Bahrain.
 
• The initiative builds on the 2019 MoU signed during PM Modi’s visit to Bahrain and reaffirmed at the 4th India-Bahrain High Joint Commission Meeting (December 2024).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **NPCI International Payments Limited (NIPL):**__

 __
 
• International arm of NPCI, responsible for expanding India’s digital payment technologies globally.
 
• Promotes systems like UPI and RuPay in foreign markets.
 
 
 
• **BENEFIT Company (Bahrain):**__
 __
 
• Bahrain’s national electronic network for financial transactions.
 
• Operates EFTS and services such as Fawri, Fawri+, and Fawateer.
 
 
 
• **Unified Payments Interface (UPI):**__ A real-time payment system developed by NPCI that enables instant fund transfers between bank accounts using mobile devices.
 
• __**Bilateral Ties:**__ India-Bahrain trade (2024–25) stood at USD 1.64 billion, with two-way investments exceeding USD 2 billion, reflecting strong economic and fintech cooperation.

questions.question: Where is the World Boxing Cup Finals 2025 being hosted in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Greater Noida.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The World Boxing Cup Finals 2025 are being held at the Shaheed Vijay Singh Pathik Sports Complex in Greater Noida from November 17 to 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **India is hosting the final stage of the 2025 World Boxing Cup Series, which follows earlier stages in Brazil, Poland, and Kazakhstan.**
 
• **Approximately 130 boxers from 18 countries will compete in the event, with the best 8 boxers of the year in each of the 20 categories participating.**
 
• **India is competing in all 20 categories, with top boxers like Minakshi Hooda, Nikhat Zareen, Jaismine Lamboria, and Saweety Boora in action.**
 
• **The event marks India’s first major international boxing event at home after hosting the World Championships in 2023.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **World Boxing Cup Finals**__

 __
 
• A prestigious event that showcases the top boxing talent globally.
 
• The final stage is being held in Greater Noida after earlier stages in Brazil, Poland, and Kazakhstan.
 
 
 
• **India’s Boxing Team**__
 __
 
• India is competing in all 20 categories with several top boxers, including Nikhat Zareen and Saweety Boora.
 
• India hopes for strong medal performances, particularly in both men’s and women’s boxing categories.
 
 
 
• **Boxing Federation of India**__
 
 
• Led by President Ajay Singh, the Federation has worked towards improving India’s boxing rankings.
 
• This event is a reflection of India’s growing presence in world boxing.

questions.question: Which historical event is the film "120 Bahadur" based on?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Battle of Rezang La.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **"120 Bahadur," a war epic starring Farhan Akhtar, is based on the legendary 1962 Battle of Rezang La.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The film is set to release across India’s defense theater network, making exhibition history.**
 
• **It is based on the Battle of Rezang La, where 120 Indian soldiers held their ground against 3,000 Chinese troops during the 1962 Sino-Indian War.**
 
• **The film has earned widespread praise for its trailer and resonated deeply with audiences.**
 
• **The paid previews were launched on November 18, coinciding with the 63rd anniversary of the battle.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Battle of Rezang La (1962)**__

 __
 
• One of the most heroic chapters of the Sino-Indian War, where 120 Indian soldiers made a last stand against overwhelming Chinese forces.
 
• Despite being outnumbered, the Indian soldiers displayed immense courage and resilience in the battle.
 
 
 
• **120 Bahadur Film**__
 __
 
• Directed by Excel Entertainment and Trigger Happy Studios, the film portrays the bravery of Indian soldiers at the Battle of Rezang La.
 
• Set to release in defense theaters, highlighting its significance in India’s military history.
 
 
 
• **Farhan Akhtar’s Role**__
 
 
• Farhan Akhtar stars in the film, bringing the heroic story of the battle to the big screen.
 
• His portrayal aims to honor the bravery and sacrifice of the soldiers involved in the battle.
